intro: Follower Pulse privately compares complete Twitch follower snapshots. It never posts unfollow names to chat, Discord, or overlays.

sections.title: 1. Turn on Follower Pulse
sections.description: Import the Streamer.bot package and approve Snapshot Page before enabling. The first complete scan creates a silent baseline.

sections.title: 2. Follower check safety
sections.description: Twelve-hour checks and two complete missing snapshots are recommended. Failed, partial, changing, or unauthorized results never become unfollows. Temporary failures retry automatically, waiting a little longer each time.

sections.title: 3. Private history
sections.description: Only Twitch IDs, current names, follow times, and recent changes are kept on this computer, up to the set limits.

sections.title: Setup and manual check
sections.description: Snapshot Page must remain triggerless. Reconcile Now may be attached to a creator-only hotkey or deck button.
sections.notice: The broadcaster connection must grant moderator:read:followers. Twitch credentials stay inside Streamer.bot and are used only with GET https://api.twitch.tv/helix/channels/followers. Tokens are never passed on, logged, or saved by StreamBridge.
